title: Lunar laser reflectors
summary: James Fox tells of Lunar laser reflectors, about 1969-1972 at The Moon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "Ah, you know, we can see the the laser. We can put a laser on some of the things that we left on the surface of the moon."

plain: James Fox, speaking as a witness on Jesse Michels's podcast, repeats what he says a man named Ben told him about the Apollo Moon missions of 1969 to 1972. According to Fox, Ben said that we can shine a laser onto some of the equipment the astronauts left on the Moon's surface. He tells it as a way of showing that people really did go there and left things behind that can still be found.
